summary: Global Industrial Co filed an 8-K to disclose Amendment No. 4 to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase. The amendment extends the credit facility's maturity date from October 19, 2026 to June 30, 2031. No other material terms—such as pricing changes, incremental facilities, or structural alterations—are reported. The filing is a routine debt-refinancing event, not a special situation. The registrant is the borrower (issuer). Investors should monitor for any subsequent amendments or draws under the credit line, but no special-situation catalyst is present.
